recovery.beforeNpmPublication: Delete the draft GitHub release, close the generated index pull request, and delete its branch.
recovery.afterNpmPublication: Keep the immutable npm package, draft release, and index pull request for explicit recovery; never claim the npm version was rolled back.
recovery.subscriberUpdates: Disabled until Cratis/Workflows#73 is implemented and canaried.
recovery.marketplaces: Manual publisher-account and vendor-review handoff remains tracked by Cratis/AI#147.
